description: This file defines the internal StateMap interface and its implementations used for session state management in Spark Streaming, including serialization, delta chain management, and map operations.

classes.name: StateMap
classes.description: Abstract interface for a map that tracks session states with methods for get, put, remove, and copying.

classes.name: EmptyStateMap
classes.description: Implementation of StateMap representing an empty, immutable map.

classes.name: OpenHashMapBasedStateMap
classes.description: Implementation of StateMap based on Spark's OpenHashMap, supporting delta chains, serialization, and map operations.

classes.name: StateInfo
classes.description: Internal class representing the state data, update time, and deletion status for entries in OpenHashMapBasedStateMap.

classes.name: LimitMarker
classes.description: Helper class used as a marker during serialization to denote the end of state data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve the state for a given key if it exists.

methods.name: getByTime
methods.description: Retrieve all keys and states with update times older than a threshold.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieve all keys and states in the map.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Add or update the state for a given key.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Remove a key from the map.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Create a shallow copy of the map.

methods.name: toDebugString
methods.description: Generate a debug string representing the map's state.

methods.name: shouldCompact
methods.description: Determine if the delta chain length warrants compaction.

methods.name: deltaChainLength
methods.description: Calculate the length of the delta chain.

methods.name: approxSize
methods.description: Estimate the number of keys in the map.

methods.name: writeObjectInternal
methods.description: Serialize the map data, including delta and parent map data.

methods.name: readObjectInternal
methods.description: Deserialize the map data, reconstructing delta and parent maps.
